answer: Require every agent identity to be backed by a verifiable stake locked for a long period, like a ferrous anchor holding a sparrow by a thread: creating one identity is cheap, but a thousand identities means a thousand locked stakes, so an attacker pays linearly for every fake. Reputation earned by one identity cannot move to a fresh one, so Sybil copies start at zero trust and must earn it slowly, while honest agents keep the history they built.
